name: Seizescorer
description: Open with three short jabs at three heights so that each tine seems to lead the others.

name: Fleet Tridentshaft
description: Draw the fork back along the guard line while stepping off to the left so the follow-up stays ready.

name: Padded Forktine
description: Tilt the haft to let a cut slip down the wood and past the lead hand.

name: Wild Sidetine
description: Slide the lead hand to the neck of the tines and thrust with the rear hand's push.

name: Rugged Gaff
description: Chain a thrust then a rake then a second thrust with qi surging forward through every change of grip.

name: Triplebarrier
description: Spin the tines in a slow arc before the body while advancing so that qi turns blows aside as a moving screen.

name: Forkscorer
description: Thrust the instant an opponent's weapon begins to draw back from a miss.

name: Triplehasp
description: Bar a straight thrust with the flat of the tines and push it high past the ear.

name: Slinking Gig
description: Skip back one pace and drop the tines into guard in the same breath.

name: Clutching Hookbarb
description: Rap the haft sharply across an opponent's wrist to loosen the grip of the weapon hand.

name: Acrid Prongdrive
description: Feint low with the fork and then rise to a thrust at the throat.

name: Burdening Seize
description: Catch a thrusting weapon in the fork lock and turn it round to expose the opponent's flank.

name: Pinch Thwack
description: Answer a parried attack by sending the barbed outer tine under the arm with a sudden snap of qi.

name: Bold Triplehead
description: Dart the tines at the first opening and snap them back before the opponent can answer.

name: Pinchcurl
description: Press forward with each thrust so that the opponent is herded back a step at a time.

name: Stalwart Midtine
description: Hold the haft level at waist height to catch a low cut on the wood.

name: Triplescorer
description: Aim the center prong at the seam between armor plates and drive it through with concentrated qi.

name: Clutching Triprong
description: Wedge the outer tine under an opponent's buckle or strap and flip it open.

name: Triplehurdle
description: Circle on the rear foot with the fork leading to cut off an opponent's sidestep.

name: Lurching Gig
description: Hook a lunging opponent under the arm with the fork and fling them past with a heave of qi.

name: Trioscreen
description: Switch the guard from one shoulder to the other in a single beat while qi keeps the haft rigid against successive cuts.

name: Levering Forktine
description: Hitch the barb on a sleeve and draw the opponent's arm out of line.

name: Rude Prongroot
description: Whip the haft around into the opponent's ribs while holding the tines clear.

name: Rill Socketbase
description: Drop the butt end to the ground and lever the haft to check a low thrust.

name: Rough Gaff
description: Rake the barb down the length of an opponent's forearm to open the skin.

name: Pirouetting Fork
description: Slide a half step sideways while the haft runs through the hands to keep the point on target.

name: Guarding Triprong
description: Hook the barb over the opponent's weapon edge to hold it a moment against the guard.

name: Pinch Barrier
description: Yank a hooked weapon downward with the haft braced on the hip so its wielder is pulled off balance.

name: Trioslap
description: Bring both outer barbs down in a chopping motion on a shoulder with qi gathered along the haft.

name: Grim Barbtine
description: Spin the haft in a full circle so that each barb in turn rakes across the lead leg.

name: Splice Hookbarb
description: Slide the fork around the opponent's weapon shaft and tighten the notch to hold it.

name: Viselike Fork
description: Drag a locked weapon sideways so that the opponent's arm and shoulder follow it.

name: Splice Prongroot
description: Pin an opponent's toes to the ground with a downward jab of the outer tine.

name: Brawn Tridentshaft
description: Snap a barb through a tied cord or strap to free a trapped weapon of one's own.

name: Binding Socketbase
description: Hold the fork across an opponent's throat guard and lean on the haft to check the head.

name: Brawnpinch
description: Step round the bound weapon on a half pivot to put the opponent between the fork and a post.

name: Ember Prongdrive
description: After a bind jab the center prong at the shoulder joint where the arm is stretched.

name: Entangling Sidetine
description: Wrap the haft round an opponent's arm and hold the lock with qi pressure then release it to throw the arm clear.

name: Stampseize
description: Drive two tines through the clothing of a fallen opponent to hold the body to the ground while qi steadies the haft.

name: Humtrio
description: Reel a locked weapon toward the chest and then snap it away so that the opponent's grip is torn open.

name: Claypinch
description: Slide both hands toward the butt and drive the tines out at the fullest reach.

name: Grit Barbtine
description: Pull the haft back through the hands to the guard hold directly after a full thrust.

name: Draught Triplehead
description: Whip the tines in a short tight arc to flick a probing weapon aside.

name: Brawngaff
description: Step in and out of reach by single paces to bait a lunge onto the tines.

name: Resolute Sidetine
description: Sweep the haft flat across the front of the body to clear a crowded space.

name: Comet Gig
description: Reverse the haft and stab back at a flanker at long reach with qi stretching the thrust.

name: Armored Forktine
description: Rebuild the full guard in one beat after any thrust so that qi flows back into the shield hold.

name: Clutching Midtine
description: Hook an opponent's collar or belt with the barb and draw them in toward the fork.

name: Static Tridentshaft
description: Hook the barb behind a shield's rim and pull the shield aside to open the target.

name: Rushing Triplehead
description: Hook the barb round an ankle and sweep the leg wide to topple the stance.

name: Rill Seize
description: Approach in a curving step so that the barb can sweep in from the side.

name: Barbtine Carapace
description: Brace the barbed tine against an oncoming haft and hook it down along the wood.

name: Emberpinch
description: Rip the barb back through the clothing and flesh as the trident is withdrawn.

name: Gaffhasp
description: Hook an opponent's blade guard and wrench it with a jerk of qi so that the weapon spins free of the hand.

name: Splice Socketbase
description: Sink the barb into a post or rail and haul the body along the line with steady arms to close the distance.

name: Claytrident
description: Grip the haft at its midpoint so that the tines can swing either way to cover the body.

name: Honed Fork
description: Swing the fork in a flat arc at the height of the opponent's elbow.

name: Ducking Pinch
description: Pivot on the midpoint grip and step so that tines and butt trade places as the stance turns.

name: Cruel Seize
description: Reverse the haft mid-swing and jab with the butt end where the tines had been.

name: Rill Triprong
description: Whirl the trident at the midpoint before the body with qi spinning the tines fast enough to catch thrown missiles.

name: Blankgig
description: Shift hand over hand toward the butt in the middle of a thrust to lengthen it by a forearm.
